Display

Arrow keys move between counties or between districts, whichever the level control is set to. Enter opens the one you are on, Home and End jump to the first and last, plus and minus zoom, and zero fits the whole state. Precincts are too many to arrow through: open one by name from search, or from its county's precinct list.
